title: Continue simplifying Termy without changing behavior
status: CRT-024 proof complete; apply approval required
summary: CRT-024 passed baseline-plus-removal proof in disposable copies. The exact cleanup removes three manifest entries, 121 lockfile lines, and ten unreachable crypto packages while retaining rand_core for the plugin runtime. No product source has been changed.
request: Continue simplifying and organizing Termy, remove proven bloat and duplication, and preserve behavior.

in: Credible dead files, unused dependencies, forwarding-only modules, and duplicated internal implementations
Small behavior-preserving ownership and organization improvements supported by repository evidence
out: Public FFI, configuration, persistence, plugin protocol, or database contract changes
Speculative large-scale directory or architecture rewrites

impact.evidence: cargo-machete flags p256 and rand_core as unused direct dependencies of termy; source search finds no desktop use and history ties them to the removed browser surface.
marketingPanelClass and appName have no consumers; GitHubReleaseYearGroup and Sponsor are used only within their defining files.
terminal_view/mod.rs remains 6,090 lines, but its native layout types and methods are consumed across persistence, tabs, pane movement, mouse, render, tmux, and session state.

risks.failure: Removing the desktop dependency entries produces an incomplete or inconsistent lockfile or hides an indirect build requirement.
risks.evidence: Both static analyzer and repository search agree the direct entries are unused, but the current lockfile still records them under termy.
risks.mitigation: Regenerate and compile in a disposable copy, then run desktop tests, formatting, and boundaries.
risks.rollback: Restore the three manifest entries and candidate lockfile diff.

risks.failure: Removing or privatizing website exports breaks an alias-resolved, generated, or framework consumer missed by simple search.
risks.evidence: Four exports have no external repository reference, but the website uses aliases and file-route generation.
risks.mitigation: Prove the exact edits with website lint, typecheck, and production build in a disposable copy.
risks.rollback: Restore the two constants and two export qualifiers.

risks.failure: A broad native-layout extraction creates privacy churn or changes terminal session and pane behavior merely to reduce file size.
risks.evidence: Native layout state has consumers in seven sibling surfaces and persistence contracts; the existing SessionState is still a shared mutable state bag.
risks.mitigation: Defer this extraction until the dependency and website cleanup is complete, then design a separate characterized slice.
risks.rollback: Do not include terminal_view reorganization in the first batch.

contracts.name: User-visible terminal behavior
contracts.mustPreserve: Tabs, panes, rendering, input, persistence, native shell, Tmon, and tmux behavior
contracts.protection: Focused crate tests, workspace tests, Clippy, formatting, boundaries, and manual smoke checks when visual behavior is touched

contracts.name: Headless and native APIs
contracts.mustPreserve: termy_core, C header, FFI exports, and tmux control contracts
contracts.evidence: crates/core, crates/ffi/include/termy.h, and FFI contract tests
contracts.protection: Core, FFI, and native SDK checks for any adjacent candidate

contracts.name: Repository ownership policy
contracts.mustPreserve: Behavior remains in the smallest documented owner without forbidden dependency edges
